demo_vs_mainnet_comparison.finding: Official Binance Demo experienced hourly settlements averaging ~22.97 bps/h during weekend US-equity market closure, whereas Binance Mainnet settled every 8h with much smaller rates (mostly 0 bps over the weekend). Therefore funding studies MUST evaluate both actual Mainnet funding AND Demo/high-funding stress regimes separately.

review_recompute.interpretation: 旧结算时序夸大了突发高资金费下策略 B 的防御幅度：Switch48h OOS B 总资金费从 -0.133382 变为 -0.245185 USDT，总净收益从 -0.666573 变为 -0.778376 USDT。持续 Demo 高费率下 B 的空仓防御仍为零收益、零资金费；修复后仍有条件性的减亏效果。原规范结论仍为 INCONCLUSIVE，主网 OOS 的统计证据未变。结果仅适用于 NO_F11_NO_F08_STRANDED_POSITION_BASELINE，不代表完整 F11/F08，也不能把离线防御解释为已证明的正 Alpha。表中 MC 净收益均值由已报告的四位小数收益率 × 7 USDT 换算，存在至多 0.0000035 USDT 的舍入误差。
